The fix involves ensuring the current directory is Documents before creating the file. So the next step should be to use mcp_tool_cd to navigate to Documents. After that, mcp_tool_touch can safely create the file in the correct location. This aligns with the successful execution where changing to Documents first worked properly. So the immediate corrective action is to call mcp_tool_cd with folder="Documents" before attempting to create the file.
